statements.status_notes: GHSA-cq8v-f236-94qc requires crates.io rand to be compiled with its optional `log` feature plus additional runtime conditions (recursive logging touching ThreadRng while it reseeds). textnonce declares `rand = "0.7"`, which resolves to rand 0.7.3 with default features (`std`), and `cargo tree -p rand@0.7.3 -e features` confirms the optional `log` feature is inactive, so the unsound specialization is absent from the built crate graph.

GHSA-cq8v-f236-94qc requires crates.io rand to be compiled with its optional `log` feature plus additional runtime conditions (recursive logging touching ThreadRng while it reseeds). textnonce declares `rand = "0.7"`, which resolves to rand 0.7.3 with default features (`std`), and `cargo tree -p rand@0.7.3 -e features` confirms the optional `log` feature is inactive, so the unsound specialization is absent from the built crate graph.

The vulnerability in GHSA-cq8v-f236-94qc affects rand::rng(), an API introduced in rand 0.9.0. rand@0.8.5 does not contain this function and is not affected. The affected ranges are >=0.9.0,<0.9.3 and >=0.10.0,<0.10.1 only.
